# Norwich Free Walking Tours

> Daily merit-based (tip-what-it-was-worth) walking tour of Norwich, UK. Led by a local guide. Runs daily, 1h 45m, starts at The Forum.

The Real Norwich Essentials Tour is a free-to-book walking tour of Norwich city centre covering The Forum, The Guildhall, The Norwich Lanes, Norwich Market, The Arcade, London Street (the first pedestrianised street in the UK), Norwich Castle, St Andrews Hall, Elm Hill, Tombland, Fye Bridge, and Norwich Cathedral. Book a free spot online, meet the guide at The Forum, tip what the tour was worth at the end by card or cash. Guests typically tip £10 to £20 per person.

Founder + guide: Tom Thornhill, a Norwich resident who has lived in the city for over a decade and runs the walks most days. The tour functions, as guests describe it, as "a walking visitor centre with a local."

- [About Tom](https://www.norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk/about): about the guide, why he started, what to expect
- [Private Tours](https://www.norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk/private-tours): bespoke group and private tours, price on request
- [Free things to do in Norwich](https://www.norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk/things-to-do/free): a local's guide to free things to do in Norwich
- [Explore Norwich](https://www.norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk/explore): articles and guides to Norwich (where to stay, what to do, etc.)
- [Contact](https://www.norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk/contact): email, form, social links

## Key facts

- Meeting point: The Forum, Norwich (central city, next to the library), Millennium Plain, NR2 1TF
- Duration: 1 hour 45 minutes
- Schedule: daily, rain or shine
- Group size: maximum 15 per tour
- Language: English
- Cost: free to book; tip what the tour was worth at the end (guests typically tip £10 to £20 per person)
- Payment methods: card or cash (Apple Pay and Google Pay also accepted)
- Reviews: 5.0 stars on Google (45 reviews), 5.0 stars on TripAdvisor (17 reviews, all 5-star)
- Booking: https://www.norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk/book
- Contact: hello@norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk
